facts.business: Avenue Supermarts Limited (DMart) operates a national supermarket chain focused on value-retailing, offering a wide range of products across Foods, Non-Foods (FMCG), and General Merchandise & Apparel categories.

auditor.name: S R B C & Co LLP

key_risks: Impairment of investment in subsidiary Avenue E-Commerce Limited due to continued losses
Increase in finance costs due to borrowings and lease liabilities
Decrease in current ratio due to increase in borrowings and lease liabilities
Increase in debt-equity ratio due to borrowings and lease liabilities
facts.related_party_note: Proposed related party transactions with subsidiary Avenue E-Commerce Limited (AEL) for investment on preferential basis to fund operational, working capital and capex requirements; sourced from internal accruals; directors Mr. Ramakant Baheti and Mrs. Manjri Chandak are common directors; Mr. Niladri Deb is KMP in both entities; no regulatory approval required; all related parties to abstain from voting.
